mage_damage.name: Purifying Beam
mage_damage.description: A focused ray of pure white light erupts from your fingertips, searing through shadow and corruption with divine intensity.

mage_damage.name: Dawn's Wrath
mage_damage.description: Golden morning light coalesces into a blazing orb that explodes outward, banishing darkness and scorching all within its radiant embrace.

mage_damage.name: Starfall Strike
mage_damage.description: Brilliant points of starlight rain down from above like celestial arrows, each one piercing through enemies with ethereal fire.

mage_damage.name: Solar Flare
mage_damage.description: A miniature sun bursts forth in a blinding flash, releasing waves of searing light that wash over all nearby foes.

mage_damage.name: Luminous Lance
mage_damage.description: A spear of concentrated moonlight materializes and hurls itself at a single target, leaving trails of shimmering radiance in its wake.

mage_damage.name: Prism Burst
mage_damage.description: Crystalline light fractures into a rainbow of deadly beams, each one seeking a different enemy with precision and grace.

mage_damage.name: Radiant Maelstrom
mage_damage.description: A swirling vortex of liquid light engulfs the battlefield, burning away shadows while healing allies and harming enemies within its glow.

mage_damage.name: Sanctuary's Retribution
mage_damage.description: Divine light erupts in a protective circle around you, lashing out at any who dare approach with tendrils of blessed fire.

mage_damage.name: Eclipse Reversal
mage_damage.description: You tear through the veil of darkness itself, unleashing the trapped light beneath in a devastating explosion of purified energy.

mage_damage.name: Celestial Cascade
mage_damage.description: Streams of heavenly light pour down like a waterfall of liquid stars, washing over enemies in waves of burning sanctity.

healer_damage.name: Divine Beacon
healer_damage.description: A brilliant column of pure light erupts from the heavens to strike your enemy with celestial force.

healer_damage.name: Crystal Purge
healer_damage.description: Radiant energy courses through crystalline fragments, creating a searing beam that pierces through shadow magic.

healer_damage.name: Sanctified Ray
healer_damage.description: Holy light manifests as a focused lance of energy that burns away corruption and shadow.

healer_damage.name: Luminous Verdict
healer_damage.description: Divine judgment takes the form of blazing light that seeks out and punishes those who embrace darkness.

healer_damage.name: Prism Strike
healer_damage.description: Refracted light coalesces into a concentrated burst of rainbow-hued energy that overwhelms shadow defenses.

healer_damage.name: Hallowed Flare
healer_damage.description: Sacred flame wreathed in brilliant white light erupts to banish darkness and sear unholy flesh.

healer_damage.name: Dawn's Retribution
healer_damage.description: The power of sunrise channels through your divine focus to strike down creatures of shadow with merciless radiance.

healer_damage.name: Consecrated Burst
healer_damage.description: Holy light explodes outward in a concentrated blast that burns through shadow magic like morning sun through mist.

healer_damage.name: Stellar Lance
healer_damage.description: Starlight crystallizes into a piercing spear of celestial energy that cuts through darkness with divine precision.

healer_damage.name: Radiant Smite
healer_damage.description: Pure light coalesces around your weapon or hand before unleashing a devastating strike against creatures of shadow.

heal.name: Dawn's Embrace
heal.description: Gentle rays of morning light envelop the target, mending wounds with the promise of a new day.

heal.name: Crystal Clarity
heal.description: Pure crystalline light flows through the body, cleansing darkness and restoring vitality.

heal.name: Sanctuary's Blessing
heal.description: A protective aura of sacred light surrounds the target, healing their injuries while warding off shadow.

heal.name: Starlight Restoration
heal.description: Distant starlight gathers to heal wounds with the eternal wisdom of the celestial realm.

heal.name: Chapel's Grace
heal.description: Holy light radiates from blessed ground, mending the faithful with divine compassion.

heal.name: Prism of Renewal
heal.description: Rainbow light refracts through the air, each hue carrying healing energy to restore the wounded.

heal.name: Sunbeam Sanctuary
heal.description: Brilliant beams of sunlight pierce through darkness to heal and protect the righteous.

heal.name: Luminous Balm
heal.description: Soft, glowing light spreads like healing salve across wounds, soothing pain and mending flesh.

heal.name: Beacon's Touch
heal.description: A guiding light reaches out to heal the injured, offering hope in the darkest moments.

heal.name: Radiant Rebirth
heal.description: Intense white light floods through the target's body, burning away injuries and restoring them to full strength.

buff.name: Shadowmend Fortitude
buff.description: Dark tendrils weave through your wounds, accelerating healing while the shadows whisper ancient secrets of endurance.

buff.name: Umbral Vigor
buff.description: The essence of the shadow realm courses through your veins, restoring your stamina with the boundless energy of darkness.

buff.name: Covenant's Blessing
buff.description: Ancient shadow magic wraps around you like armor, increasing your resilience while purple shadows dance across your skin.

buff.name: Void Walker's Grace
buff.description: Your movements become fluid and precise as shadow energy enhances your agility, leaving faint dark wisps in your wake.

buff.name: Crystalline Shadow Surge
buff.description: Dark crystal fragments orbit your body, channeling shadow magic to dramatically boost your physical strength.

buff.name: Whispered Endurance
buff.description: The voices of the shadow realm murmur encouragement, filling you with supernatural stamina that seems to draw from the darkness itself.

buff.name: Nyx's Resilience
buff.description: Shadow energy hardens your resolve and body alike, granting enhanced durability as darkness coils protectively around you.

buff.name: Shadowweaver's Focus
buff.description: Your mind becomes sharp as obsidian as dark magic enhances your concentration, purple light flickering behind your eyes.

buff.name: Convergence Might
buff.description: The power of two realms flows through you, dramatically increasing your physical prowess as reality bends around your form.

buff.name: Abyssal Restoration
buff.description: Dark energy from the deepest shadows mends your body and spirit, restoring both health and stamina with otherworldly power.
